ModMetaData.name: Lockjaw Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces sarg.alphaanimals's `AA_Lockjaw` art (grey `AA_Lockjaw2` and mud-brown `AA_Lockjaw3` alternate texture sets — see scope note below) with custom generated art per the owner ruling in design/Jawa/worldbuilding/review/round2/decisions_propagated.json (`fauna:the_miasma:AA_Lockjaw`, `"art": "improve"` — *"Make it like a huge whale with alligator-like skin sitting and staring... then SNAP."*). LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative paths (Things/Pawn/Animal/AA_Lockjaw/AA_Lockjaw2_<facing> and AA_Lockjaw3_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
SCOPE, 2026-09-11 (LOCKJAW_ART_WIRE_IN_1, completed same day): `AA_Lockjaw`'s PawnKindDef rolls one of THREE alternate texture sets per spawn (`AA_Lockjaw` bare, `AA_Lockjaw2` grey, `AA_Lockjaw3` brown), each a full south/east/north set. This mod ships both `AA_Lockjaw3` (brown) and `AA_Lockjaw2` (grey) complete and consistent across all three facings. `AA_Lockjaw2`'s south facing initially failed the offline validator 5 times running (consistently ~20-90% too wide against the reference's narrow front-on silhouette) before being seeded from the brown sibling's successful prompt and passing on the first retry (owner ruling 2026-09-11) - live verification of the grey art was deferred at deploy time (bridge held by FOUNDRY). The bare `AA_Lockjaw` variant was never in scope for this item and is untouched.
